claims.statement: For every k>=1, the explicit 12k-bit Boolean tensor/point-defect composition F_k satisfies H(F_k)<=(1728/595)I(F_k)<3I(F_k).
For the same family and every k>=1, U(F_k)<=(1728/595)I(F_k).

The complete endpoint-centered biased-child reserve of the tensor no-go family at its 8k-bit point-defect bias is at most (1728/595) times the total physical influence of the composed Boolean function.
The independently accepted child-only obstruction admits a dimension-independent joint payment on its complete parametric family, but no universal joint theorem is proved.
